title: This Worm Lives in Water Hotter Than 140 Degrees

scenes.text: This worm lives in water hotter than 140 degrees.
It's the Pompeii worm, found on volcanic vents deep in the Pacific.
It lives about eight thousand feet down, in tubes on rocky chimneys.
Its tail sits in water between 140 and 176 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spikes above boiling don't seem to hurt it.
A worm that lives where water burns.
